incidents.body:
The issue affecting our database has been resolved, and all services are operating normally again.
The incident was caused by an issue with our database provider, which has since been resolved. We appreciate your patience while we worked with our provider to restore full service.
Thank you for your understanding. If you continue to experience any issues, please contact our support team.

incidents.body:
This incident has been resolved.
Heavy traffic on our database servers caused access issues to our content delivery servers and affected the dashboard.
We sincerely apologize for the outage and any inconvenience this may have caused.
incidents.title: Service availability limited

incidents.body:
A network-related issue caused DNS resolution failures for some of our internal services, which affected service availability for a significant portion of users during 55 minutes.
Our team identified the root cause, resolved the network/DNS issue, and services are now fully restored.
We apologize for the disruption and appreciate your patience.
